# Real official records, captured 17 November 2026

These are **historical source records**, not demonstration contracts. They are never imported into production by a migration. `manifest.json` contains SHA-256 of the committed files. Raw responses and live request logs remain in ignored `work/monitor/`; no contact emails, telephone numbers or API credentials belong in this fixture set.

* `ted.json`: 13 records returned by POST `https://api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search`, query `notice-title ~ "molybdenum" SORT BY publication-date DESC`, scope `ALL`. Projection retains publication number/date, English title, buyer names (including original-language fallbacks), buyer country, notice/form type, CPV; optional large multilingual links and other title translations are omitted. Public metadata attribution: European Union, TED. [Search API documentation](https://docs.ted.europa.eu/api/latest/search.html), [reuse documentation](https://docs.ted.europa.eu/ODS/latest/reuse/search-api.html), [legal notice](https://ted.europa.eu/en/legal-notice).
* `usaspending.json`: 20 federal award search hits (19 material candidates; `MOLY SPOOL` remains unclassified and is skipped), POST `https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/`, `award_type_codes=[A,B,C,D]`, keywords exactly `MONITOR_US_TERMS` in `shared/monitorSources.ts`; selected fields are the eight award/description/agency/date/ID fields in `monitorRequest`. Attribution: USAspending.gov, US Treasury. **Award Amount means cumulative obligations**, not an allocated goods price. No mass is inferred from amounts. [Official API documentation](https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/intro-tutorial), [about](https://www.usaspending.gov/about).
* `contracts-finder.json`: two releases. One is the Nent Haggs Optimisation record selected from `https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Published/Notices/OCDS/Search?publishedFrom=2026-11-15T00:00:00Z&publishedTo=2026-11-17T00:00:00Z&limit=100`; it mentions metals in remediation scope and must be moderated. The other was retrieved directly, HTTP 200, from `https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/Published/Notice/releases/7c647f54-d021-45c0-8e39-42091875789f.json`: Birmingham spherical tungsten powder award, published 23 October 2023, GBP 30,266.39, ACANTECS LIMITED, no published mass. `parties` is omitted to avoid storing contact information in git. The package-level `uri` refers to the first search, not the appended second release; the two origins are documented here. Contains public sector information licensed under the [Open Government Licence v3.0](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). [Official download/API guidance](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/open-contracting).

Snapshots test reproducibility, including false positives. Current source searches have moving results, so current page counts need not match these fixtures. Synthetic revision/cancellation/arithmetic inputs exist only in isolated tests and are marked `TEST`; they are excluded from reported real-event counts and browser snapshots.
